observed.caption: White laundry hangs on yellow lines on a blue balcony railing overlooking a green forested valley and hills lined with wind turbines under a pale blue sky.
observed.description: In the foreground a blue metal balcony railing runs diagonally with two yellow clotheslines strung above it holding white garments secured with small colorful clothespins. Beyond the balcony a dense expanse of green trees and vegetation fills a valley, with scattered buildings and a structure with a weathered corrugated metal roof visible on the lower right. In the background rolling green hills rise under a pale blue clear sky, with numerous white wind turbines lined along the ridgeline and a cluster of houses nestled among trees on the hillside.
